scenes.text: This is the deck builder. You describe the deck you need, and it builds it from the approved template, so the result is always on brand.
scenes.action: Empty editor, zoom on the prompt box.

scenes.text: Start with the brief. Say what the deck is for, who it is for, and how many slides you want. The more concrete the brief, the better the deck.
scenes.action: Type a brief: 'Eight slides for the donor steering committee on school connectivity in Kenya in 2025.'

scenes.text: Then attach your material: a PDF, a Word or PowerPoint file, an Excel sheet, or a link in the brief. The deck is written from it, and the brief decides the angle.
scenes.action: Click the plus, attach an Excel file and a PDF; the chips appear.

scenes.text: Turn on Chapters if the deck needs an agenda and section dividers. Leave it off for a deck that runs straight through.
scenes.action: Zoom on the Chapters pill, toggle it.

scenes.text: Press Generate. If the material leaves something open, like which sheet to use or what to headline, you get a few questions written for your files. Answer them, or skip.
scenes.action: Click Generate; the questions dialog opens; pick two answers; press Generate.

scenes.text: The slides arrive one by one. Charts use the numbers from your sheet, and photos come from the Giga library.
scenes.action: The pill travels down into the slide bar; slides land; zoom on a chart slide.

scenes.text: Need more? Add slides lets you describe what is missing, and it lands where it belongs. Or pick any layout yourself with Add slide.
scenes.action: Open Add slides, type a short request, submit; then open the Add slide picker and insert a layout.

scenes.text: Press play to present full screen, with the template's animations. Use the arrow keys, and Escape to leave.
scenes.action: Click the play button; the cover animates; advance twice; Escape.

scenes.text: Finally, download the deck as PDF, PowerPoint or HTML. Nothing is stored on a server, so keep the HTML file: upload it here again to continue editing.
scenes.action: Open the Download menu, zoom on the three options.

scenes.text: Click any text on a slide to rewrite it. The text resizes itself to fit the layout.
scenes.action: Click a title, type a new one; zoom in.

scenes.text: Edit with AI rewrites a slide from a one-line instruction, and shows the same content in other layouts, so you can switch with a click. It never changes your photos.
scenes.action: Open Edit with AI; type an instruction; hover the layout previews; pick one.

scenes.text: Click a photo to replace it. Choose from the Giga library, upload your own, or render a live map of any country. Drag the photo to reframe it.
scenes.action: Click a photo; the picker opens on Library; pick a photo; drag it to reframe.

scenes.text: Icons are picked to match each card. To change one, click it and search the full icon set.
scenes.action: Click an icon card's icon; search 'school'; pick one.

scenes.text: Click a chart to open its data. Edit the values, rename the series, or add a row, and the chart updates as you type.
scenes.action: Click a grouped chart; the Data panel opens; change a value; the bars move.

scenes.text: On a progress slide, click a stage to mark it as in progress. Everything before it shows as done.
scenes.action: Click the third stage; the bar fills.

scenes.text: Add an element to a slide, or hover one and delete it. Undo brings anything back.
scenes.action: Click Element; hover a card; click the cross; press Undo.

scenes.text: Drag the thumbnails to reorder the deck. When it is ready, press play to present, or download it.
scenes.action: Drag a thumbnail; end on the play button.
